evidence: The factual claim holds but nothing depends on it. _reviewer_environment (products/stamphog/backend/temporal/activities.py:167-177) is the PR's new code: it stamps stamphog_self_driving_review=True into STAMPHOG_EXTRA_PROPERTIES from run.output['inbox_review'], and the comment at 173-174 scopes the flag to 'the engine's completed events and LLM traces' (consumed by tools/pr-approval-agent/review_pr.py:817-825 and reviewer.py:324-330 via analytics_extra_properties). mark_review_failed (activities.py:820-876) emits stamphog_review_failed with only stamphog_repo/pr_number/team_id/runtime/error (864-875) and no run id or flag; the PR's activities.py patch has three hunks (@@-165, @@-228, @@-438) and never touches that function, so the failure event's property set is unchanged master behaviour. No consumer in this tree needs the flag on failures: grepping *.md/*.json/*.yml/*.ts/*.sql for stamphog_review_failed or stamphog_self_driving_review finds nothing beyond README.md:224 (which documents stamphog_review_completed only); the only in-tree statement of a consumer is the generic 'dashboards see hosted breakage next to the review-completed events' comment (activities.py:859-861, echoed by test_integration.py:749-752), and the PR body mentions no dashboard, monitor, or rollout metric. The 'cannot isolate' claim is also overstated: the failure event's distinct_id is pull_request.author_login (activities.py:865, populated from the PR payload at tasks.py:332), self-driving PRs are authored by the App's bot login (test_integration.py:1393-1396 uses posthog-code[bot]), and every other bot-authored PR is dropped pre-run by _review_skip_reason (tasks.py:229-231) unless it is the same carve-out (tasks.py:870-881), so failed runs from that distinct_id are the self-driving failures. The authoritative record is not lost either: ReviewRun.output['inbox_review'] is persisted at run creation (tasks.py:1176-1181, 1229) and returned read-only with status/error by ReviewRunSerializer (products/stamphog/backend/presentation/serializers.py:363-380) and the stamphog_review_runs_list MCP tool (products/stamphog/mcp/tools.yaml:192). This is a telemetry-completeness wish on a pre-existing event with no consumer that breaks.
notes: Would move to consider if an in-tree dashboard, alert, or rollout gate on stamphog_review_failed were shown to filter on stamphog_self_driving_review or stamphog_review_run_id, if the PR itself had introduced or edited the failure event, or if the PR body stated a self-driving failure-rate criterion for the rollout. Would not change severity above consider in any case: the flag is still recoverable from the DB/API and from the failure event's distinct_id.
